_provenance.notes: The IPHC setline survey is the primary source of Pacific halibut abundance data. Standardized setline surveys have been conducted at fixed stations since 1923, providing one of the longest continuous fishery-independent abundance indices in the world. CPUE (Catch-Per-Unit-Effort) from these surveys drives the stock assessment. The IPHC Regulatory Area 3A (Gulf of Alaska) and 2C (Southeast Alaska) are the most productive. Declining CPUE from the mid-1990s to mid-2010s reflected smaller average fish size due to density-dependent effects and high exploitation rates.
